relationships.subject: Morphine
relationships.evidence_quote: repeated morphine administration can trigger the transition from analgesia to hyperalgesia and hypersensitivity to stimuli (i.e., OIH)

relationships.subject: Alternative splicing
relationships.evidence_quote: Genes that participate in glutamatergic synapse (e.g., Grip1, Grin1, Wnk3), myelin protein processes (e.g., Mbp, Mpz), and axon guidance presented absolute and relative splicing associated with OIH.

key_findings: Alternative splicing of glutamatergic synapse, myelin and axon guidance genes is associated with OIH in mouse trigeminal ganglia and nucleus accumbens.
Trigeminal ganglia showed prevalent differentially spliced transcription factors (Ciart, Ablim2, Pbx1, Arntl2).
